name: forest-lake
summary: Sand beach on the north shore of a freshwater lake, jungle and oak woodland behind it, grass plains with pigs across the water. Spring day 1, 1000 ticks, clear.

features.water: lake surface y 62 along the beach; stand at (40, 63, -52) to drink. Raw water poisons 18% of drinks: boil it in a fired pot for safety. A river biome lies west of the lake (about -16, 64, 0).
features.wood: about 60 trunks within 48 blocks, mostly jungle with oak, e.g. oak at (12, -57), (29, -76); jungle at (22, -66), (48, -62).
features.stone: loose stones on the beach and the lake shore at (38, 64, -53), (28, 66, -56), (56, 63, -64); 35 within 64 blocks (cobbles lie along the waterline).
features.clay: under the lake off the beach at (46, 55, -49), 7 deep; shallow clay banks on the south shore around (13..17, 62, -23..-13).
features.food: no wild food plants within 64 blocks; the nearest wild melons are about 139 blocks north-west at (-27, 79, -175), (-22, 80, -177). A chicken on the beach, pigs and sheep on the south plains (about 20, 63, -20) and salmon in the lake were seen in an earlier copy and not counted again.
features.dirt: grass and dirt on the slopes behind the beach (x 34..37, y 64..67) and across the plains south of the lake.
features.fibre: wild plant patches (plant fibre) in the woods behind the beach: (45, 64, -58), (52, 64, -68), (52, 65, -74), (19, 63, -52); 21 within 64 blocks. No wild flax within 64 blocks.
features.shells: freshwater shells on the lake shore: (42, 63, -32), (64, 63, -58), (37, 63, -32); 10 patches within 64 blocks.
features.dye_plants: indigo in the jungle at (43, 65, -84) (1 stand within 64 blocks, 19 generated in all); one weld stand at (37, 63, 31); madder only far off at (-148, 108, 99); no woad.
features.medicine_plants: fever-bark saplings in the jungle to the north at (23, 76, -181), (24, 75, -182) (8 generated in all, nearest 128 blocks); no meadowsweet or bog moss.
features.ornamental_stone: no marble in the generated area. Topaz in a tin lode at (185, 44, -183), (190, 43, -180), about 190 blocks north-east and 20 below ground. Amber-bearing sand at (210, 53, 53), (211, 53, 52), about 200 blocks south-east. Lapis ore deep under the beach, nearest (35, 16, -55).
features.spring_food: wild peas on the grass south of the beach at (38, 63, -27), (36, 63, -27), (36, 63, -26) (3 stands within 64 blocks); ramsons in the woods to the west at (-45, 89, -78), (-46, 88, -77), nearest about 90 blocks. Both are picked in spring.
features.coffee_and_tea: wild tea in the jungle hills to the north-west at (5, 75, -94), (4, 82, -97), nearest about 54 blocks; wild coffee in the jungle about 65 blocks north at (57, 68, -117), (59, 68, -117). Coffee is picked in autumn and winter, tea from spring to autumn.

notes: Regenerated 2026-11-21 from the same seed with cobbles along the waterline (strandline loose stones). World spawn (42, 64, -54), respawn_radius 0, time 1000, clear, easy. Chunks within about 160 blocks of the spawn were generated when saved. Earlier copies: forest-lake-pre-strand, forest-lake-pre-farming, forest-lake-pre-luxury, forest-lake-pre-fibre.
